shorts.title: What you will learn: switch and case
shorts.hook: One missing word makes a switch run two cases.
shorts.script: One missing word makes a switch run two cases. Today we build a menu with switch. It is a neat way to pick one action from many. A switch statement compares one value with many case labels. It jumps to the matching case. The break keyword ends that case. The default case handles all other values. Without break, the program falls through into the next case. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: switch and case.

shorts.title: switch and case in one minute
shorts.hook: A switch statement compares one value with many case labels.
shorts.script: A switch statement compares one value with many case labels. It jumps to the matching case. The break keyword ends that case. The default case handles all other values. Without break, the program falls through into the next case. Think of a menu board. You say a number, and the kitchen makes that dish. Day is three. The switch looks at the value of day. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: switch and case in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The choice is the letter b.
shorts.script: The choice is the letter b. Two case labels can share one action. Here the letters a and A both add. Our letter b matches this case. It prints Buy. Break then ends the switch. Default would handle any other letter. The program prints Buy. Switch compares one value with many cases. Break ends a case. Default handles all other values. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A missing break
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in switch and case?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in switch and case? Bug of the Day. Case three has no break. The program prints Wednesday, and then Thursday too. It falls through into the next case, and the compiler warns about it. Without a break, the switch does not stop. Add break at the end of each case. Without break, the program keeps running into the next case. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A missing break.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you make a calculator menu in switch and case?
shorts.script: Can you make a calculator menu in switch and case? I asked the switch for a table at the restaurant. It gave me two, because I forgot the break. Use a switch on a character. For plus, minus and times, print the result of seven and three. Write your answer in the comments. Switch compares one value with many cases. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
